sql:
with c as (
 select market_ticker mt, captured_at, hours_to_close h, hours_to_expiration he, yes_bid, yes_ask, no_bid, no_ask, depth_at_best_bid dbb, depth_at_best_ask dba, volume
 from mmsell_candidate_ticks where series='KXRAIN'
)
select case when h is null then 'null' when h<3 then '0-3h' when h<6 then '03-6h' when h<12 then '06-12h' when h<24 then '12-24h' else '24h+' end hb,
 case when yes_ask<=4 then 'ya<=4' when yes_ask<=7 then 'ya5-7' when yes_ask<=10 then 'ya8-10' when yes_ask<=15 then 'ya11-15' else 'ya16+' end pb,
 count(*) ticks, count(distinct mt) mkts, min(captured_at)::date first, max(captured_at)::date last,
 percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by dbb) med_dbb, percentile_disc(0.1) within group (order by dbb) p10_dbb, percentile_disc(0.9) within group (order by dbb) p90_dbb,
 percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by dba) med_dba, percentile_disc(0.9) within group (order by dba) p90_dba,
 round(avg(yes_ask-yes_bid),1) spread, percentile_disc(0.5) within group (order by volume) med_vol
from c group by 1,2 order by 1,2
